34. We have considered the submissions made by the parties. While the parties have made elaborate submissions on whether or not the Petitioner can withdraw this Petition at this stage, we do not find it necessary to deal with them in great detail, as we find that the Petitioner’s plea presupposes that the present Petition has already been rendered infructuous. While it is true that the subsequent developments as put forth by the parties have been taken note of, and the proceedings that transpired thereafter also reflect that the Scheme is no longer needed, the Commission may still be required to rule  on this aspect. Further, keeping in view the request of the learned counsel for the Respondents, as made during the course of arguments on 18.3.2026, we also allow all the parties to refer to and rely upon the pleadings, proceedings, submissions and admissions, if any, forming part of the present Petition in accordance with law.
